preservedResponsibilities: Responsibility split of existing portable automatic paragraph-style identity encoding consumed by XMLTextParagraphExport. Fields retain old ordering and append direct drawing fill values. The string key is a local representation, not a native ABI.
omittedResponsibilities: Full native auto-style pool/service graph is not claimed by this key projection.
